$comment: Reviewed, non-secret routing control surface for delegated Hermes workers.
This file contains NO credentials, tokens, keys or account identifiers.
It records provider qualification state only. Credentials remain in the
profile .env that the delegated runtime links read-only.
Editing this file is the supported way to change live routing eligibility;
it deliberately avoids an unsafe direct edit of the read-only-mounted root
Provider order is the accepted canonical policy and must not be reordered

nvidia.reason: NVIDIA direct completed the bounded alternate attempt in the task-bound authority pilot with exact-output evidence.

openrouter.reason: OpenRouter free lane is the current live delegated route. Only :free models are qualified; account and upstream model limits remain conservative.

gemini.reason: Gemini direct is live and authenticated; the pilot observed HTTP 429 free-tier quota exhaustion, which the runtime classifies as a bounded-recoverable rate limit.

nous.reason: Nous is free-tier eligible but operationally blocked: the delegated-worker OAuth-lock path is not writable without broadening credential access. Preserved as a discovered provider record; promote only after independent account, exact-output and delegated-tool qualification.

ollama.reason: Ollama is quarantined and ineligible for critical apply work until a current local service health check, model availability, exact-output response, tool execution, file write/read-back and structured evidence completion all pass. Preserved as a discovered provider record.
